svg.title: Two field-line diagrams for point charges of equal size. Left: a positive and a negative charge. Field lines leave the positive charge, curve across and end on the negative charge; the lines are most crowded on the straight line between them. Right: two positive charges. Field lines leave both charges and bend away from each other. Midway between the charges there is a gap with no lines, marked N for neutral point, where the field is zero.
